prompt: Classify the selected pixels in the upper-left TARGET panel. In an isolated panel the non-gray pixels are selected. In a photo panel a visible cyan outline marks the selection. The text header is only an ID. If no selection is visible in the upper-left panel, answer no_selection, even if there are visible objects elsewhere. Use any other panels only for context. Classify the selected object itself. If it contains both a wire and a background object, use mixed. Return one JSON object with target_id (copy {target}), category, reason (up to 15 words). Category choices: no_selection, vehicle, road_or_ground, pole_hardware, building, vegetation, other_background, wire, mixed, unclear.
control_rule: per photo and method, target_present=false and decision=recheck required for automatic exclusions
selection_rule: exclude only valid background decision with present target and explicit background category, under passing control
